purpose: Map neutral-standing shoulder-girdle orientation evidence into the established HGPT world basis without freezing absolute shoulder coordinates.

source_neutral_orientation.population: pooled 100 volunteers / 200 shoulders; retained historical input, not male-only

clavicle_endpoint_length_for_relative_ve.note: Historical illustrative length. Endpoint compatibility with Matsumura surface landmarks and articular-centre chord is not established; do not select joint coordinates from this vector.

mean_SC_to_AC_relative_vector_mm.derivation: L*cos(elevation)*cos(retraction) lateral; L*cos(elevation)*sin(retraction) posterior; L*sin(elevation) superior
mean_SC_to_AC_relative_vector_mm.scope: Historical synthetic vector only; key name does not establish articular-centre endpoints or world-axis validity.

sign_interpretation.retraction: positive posterior (+Y) displacement of AC relative to SC in neutral standing
sign_interpretation.elevation: positive superior (+Z) displacement of AC relative to SC

scapular_orientation_policy.representation: store anatomical rotations in the scapular/thorax joint frame; do not encode them as raw Blender XYZ Euler angles
scapular_orientation_policy.requirement: Use the existing ISB/scapular landmark frame (AA/TS/AI) to transform these semantic rotations into HGPT world matrices after the new scapular local frame is constructed.

hard_checks: left/right clavicle relative vectors mirror only in mediolateral sign
retraction moves both AC points posteriorly (+Y)
elevation moves both AC points superiorly (+Z)
relative-vector magnitude equals the selected straight SC-to-AC endpoint length
scapular semantic rotations are never copied directly into Blender Euler channels without frame transformation

source_semantics_review.confirmed_error: The source SC/AC labels denote extremal surface landmarks, not articular centres; pooled means were also being used without male-only context.
required_before_selection: Match length endpoints to source surface landmarks or explicitly derive surface-to-articular offsets.
Construct canonical IJ/C7/PX/T8 thorax frame before source-to-world mapping.
Resolve clinical rotation sequence/signs and stature context.
